ayahOccurrences.text: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form II) imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُبَذِّرْ is in the derivative form: تُبَذِّرُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ذ/ر   b–dh–r seed, seedling, to sow
; to disseminate; to divulge; to squander, to waste.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تُبَذِّرُ tubadhdhir; تَبْذِيرٌ tabdhır and مُبَذِّرِين mubadhdhirın
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تُبَذِّرُ tubadhdhir [imperf. of v. II بَذَّرَ badhdhara, trans.; v. n. تَبْذِيرٌ tabdhır] to squander, to waste away

(17:26) وَءَاتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَى حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَلاَ تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا give relatives their due, and the needy, and travellers–do not squander your wealth wastefully.

entries.definitionHtml:
تُبَذِّرُ tubadhdhir [imperf. of v. II بَذَّرَ badhdhara, trans.; v. n. تَبْذِيرٌ tabdhır] to squander, to waste away

entries.label: مُبَذِّرِين
entries.definitionHtml:
مُبَذِّرِين mubadhdhirın [pl. of act. part. مُبَذِّرٌ mubadhdhir] spendthrifts, squanderers

(17:27) إِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوا إِخْوَانَ الشَّيَاطِينِ squanderers were ever the brothers of the devils.
